title: Turns Out We Blew Up All Those Boats in the Caribbean for Nothing
excerpt: As if we needed more confirmation that Pete Hegseth and our defense department are both psychotic and ineffectual.
content_html:
2 min read

Granted, it is a few dozen bungled policies ago, but remember when we were blowing up fishing boats in the Caribbean as part of the administration’s Operation Dude Bro antidrug strategy? Well, the results are in, and they are sadly predictable. From The Washington Post:

In a recent assessment reviewed by The Washington Post, DEA analysts found the strikes had failed to affect the supply or price of cocaine in the United States and had led traffickers to diversify beyond go-fast boats and to avoid international waters, opting instead for larger boats and hemming close to coastlines, where U.S. forces are less likely to open fire. In a closed-door briefing last month, Pentagon officials told lawmakers the strikes in international waters off South and Central America had not reduced its purity.

On the one hand, it’s somewhat comforting. We now know that this misbegotten band of boobs and yahoos has formulated an antidrug policy that’s as futile and dumbassed as those of every other administration that killed people with promiscuous glee, blowing fishermen out of the water and claiming, utterly without evidence, that they were all drug couriers. The psychopathy is the difference.

Traffickers are also relying more on aircraft, which take off from clandestine airstrips along the Colombian-Venezuelan border and head east to Guyana and Suriname to avoid U.S. forces, according to the DEA assessment. “When you squeeze the balloon on one side, it always expands on the other side,” one DEA official told The Post. “They always find the weak spots and exploit them.” The official spoke on the condition of anonymity because they were not authorized to discuss the subject publicly.

I’m sure there will be repercussions among the boobs and yahoos, not about the failure of the murderous policy but against whoever it was who leaked the documentation of the murderous policy’s abject failure. Maybe the Pentagon and the DEA, staffed by administration nominees, are now both run by the Deep State.

Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said Operation Southern Spear was accomplishing “exactly what it was designed to do: detect, disrupt and dismantle designated terrorist organizations and the networks they rely on to traffic narcotics, generate illicit revenue, and threaten the security of the United States and the Western Hemisphere.
“Transnational criminal organizations have continually adapted their tactics for decades,” Parnell told The Post. “That does not indicate the pressure is ineffective. It demonstrates that we are imposing systemic friction on their operations.”

But ... but ... he alone can fix it. Remember? I guess now it’s he alone can impose systemic friction.

At least the lives of several thousand game fish were saved.

content_html_zh:
2 分钟阅读

诚然，这是数十年前的拙劣政策，但还记得当我们炸毁加勒比海的渔船作为政府“花花公子兄弟行动”反毒品战略的一部分吗？ 好吧，结果已经出来了，而且可悲的是它们是可以预见的。 来自华盛顿邮报：

在《华盛顿邮报》最近审查的一份评估中，缉毒局分析师发现，袭击并未影响美国可卡因的供应或价格，并导致贩运者采取多样化行动，不再使用快艇，而是避开国际水域，选择较大的船只，并靠近海岸线，因为那里美军不太可能开火。 在上个月的一次闭门简报中，五角大楼官员告诉立法者，南美洲和中美洲附近国际水域的袭击并没有降低其纯度。

一方面，这有点令人欣慰。 我们现在知道，这群不怀好意的混蛋和雅胡斯制定了一项反毒品政策，与其他政府的政策一样徒劳和愚蠢，他们以混杂的欢乐杀人，把渔民从水中吹走，并在完全没有证据的情况下声称他们都是毒品运送者。 精神病态就是区别。

根据 DEA 的评估，贩运者还更多地依赖飞机，这些飞机从哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉边境的秘密机场起飞，向东飞往圭亚那和苏里南，以避开美军。 “当你在一侧挤压气球时，它总是会在另一侧膨胀，”一位 DEA 官员告诉《华盛顿邮报》。 “他们总是能找到弱点并加以利用。” 该官员不愿透露姓名，因为他们无权公开讨论该主题。

我确信，胸部和雅虎之间将会产生影响，不是针对谋杀政策的失败，而是针对泄露谋杀政策惨败记录的人。 也许由政府提名人组成的五角大楼和缉毒局现在都由深层政府管理。

五角大楼首席发言人肖恩·帕内尔表示，“南方之矛行动”正在实现“正是其设计目的：侦查、瓦解和瓦解指定的恐怖组织及其所依赖的贩运毒品、产生非法收入并威胁美国和西半球安全的网络。”
“数十年来，跨国犯罪组织不断调整其策略，”帕内尔告诉《华盛顿邮报》。 “这并不表明压力无效。 这表明我们正在对他们的运营施加系统性摩擦。”

但 ... 但 ... 他一个人就能解决这个问题。 记住？ 我想现在只有他一个人才能施加系统性摩擦。

至少数千条猎鱼的生命得以挽救。
